request.agency: Municipality of Gattaran (Office of the Municipal Mayor)
request.subject: Citizen's Charter and directory of municipal offices
request.requestText: Better Gattaran maintainers respectfully request a copy of the current Citizen's Charter of the Municipality of Gattaran under Republic Act No. 11032, and a directory of municipal offices showing office names, the position of each office head, office location, hours, and official office contact lines.
